scenario: [LEXP.3.2] x.bit_length ([LGRA.9.6.2]): the number of bits needed to represent |x|. |INT64_MIN| = 2^63 needs 64. Path: builtins.c builtin_bit_length, which formed |x| as `-args[0].i` in int64_t -- undefined behaviour at INT64_MIN (audit finding I4) -- now int_ops.h ds_i64_bit_length, on the unsigned magnitude. libds only: the Mercury runtime does not implement bit_length and refuses the artefact at load. fact_count 2 = T plus the Hit the rule emits.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where t.x.bit_length == 64
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
